decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint fits the firm's core pipeline business and moved from a mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019, so the option has shown value and is cheap to keep in a range of related fittings.

The powder-coated public waste bin uses the firm's existing coating and fabrication capability, so carrying it costs little, but it sits outside the core water business and there is no evidence of its results since 2019, so the option stays open with notable risk of abandonment.

The waste bin with ashtray is a variant within the same street-furniture line, so keeping it is cheap, though as a niche variant it is the more likely candidate to be cut if the line turns out to underperform.

The outdoor ashtrays are a low-cost option that uses existing coating equipment, but they are peripheral to the pipeline business and their prospects are still unresolved, so they stay on the market for now with a meaningful chance of being dropped.
